response:
FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans over the rolling hills and lush forests of the kingdom, but something is off. The once-majestic stone walls now seem dull and grey, the flags bearing the royal crest now faded and worn. The king, KING ARIN, sits on his throne, surrounded by his advisors.

KING ARIN
(to his advisors)
I have a vision, my friends. A vision of a new era for our kingdom. An era of... (he pauses, searching for the right words)...futurism.

ADVISOR 1
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty?

KING ARIN
(nodding)
Yes. We will embrace the latest trends from the city. The sleek lines, the neon lights, the... (he gestures to a nearby servant)...the futuristic attire.

The servant, a young man with a messy mop of hair, steps forward.

SERVANT
Yes, Your Majesty. I have brought some... (he holds up a garment with a garish, neon-colored pattern)...inspiration.

KING ARIN
(impressed)
Ah, excellent. We will make this the new standard for our court.

CUT TO:

INT. CASTLE HALLWAY - DAY

The king's advisors are now dressed in the new, futuristic attire, looking like they just stepped out of a bad 80s music video. The walls are adorned with neon lights, and the floors are covered in a strange, glowing material.

KING ARIN
(to his advisors)
Now, let us show the people of the kingdom what we have in store for them.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The king's advisors are now standing in the courtyard, surrounded by a group of peasants. They are all dressed in the new, futuristic attire, and they look... (the camera zooms in on one of the peasants, who is wearing a pair of oversized, neon-colored sunglasses)...confused.

PEASANT 1
(whispering to another peasant)
What is going on? Why are we all wearing... (he gestures to his outfit)...this?

PEASANT 2
(shrugging)
I don't know, but I think it's supposed to be some kind of... (he looks around, taking in the neon lights and futuristic decor)...futuristic thing.

CUT TO:

INT. CASTLE HALLWAY - DAY

The king is now standing in front of a large, glowing screen. It displays a video of a futuristic cityscape, complete with towering skyscrapers and flying cars.

KING ARIN
(to his advisors)
This is what we will strive for. A kingdom that is... (he pauses, searching for the right words)...futuristic.

ADVISOR 2
(nodding)
Yes, Your Majesty. We will make it happen.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans out, showing the kingdom in all its... (the camera zooms out further, showing the kingdom in all its futuristic glory)...futuristic glory.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
